testcase.name: Scenario: Dismiss Show Panels from the expanded Constrain command menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:50:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss Show Panels from the expanded Constrain command menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Sketch ribbon is visible ✔ And the Constrain additional command area is open ✔ When the user right-clicks Edit Coordinate System ✔ And the user opens Show Panels ✔ Then Sketch, Create, Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format are checked ✔ And Layout and Parameters are unchecked ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the Show Panels submenu closes and the command context menu remains open ✔ And the Constrain additional command area remains open ✔ When the user presses Escape again ✔ Then the command context menu and Constrain additional command area close ✔ And the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
